BiblicalUsage: geres means a crushing (that which is crushed), grain, grits, groats. It turns up twice, in Leviticus.
TheologicalSignificance: I read geres plainly: a crushing (that which is crushed), grain, grits, groats, and I leave it there.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
